paragraphs: Members of the Garda union have stopped a planned protest at work. The union is called the GRA.
Gardaí are Ireland's police. They planned a work-to-rule for five days this week. This means doing only the most basic tasks.
The protest would come at a very busy time. About 50 world leaders will meet in Dublin on Thursday. EU leaders will meet on Friday.
Gardaí say they work too much. Their rest days were often cancelled since July. Their extra hours were not always paid as agreed.
On Monday, the Government offered more money for overtime on Thursday. The union then voted to stop the protest. It says the talks went well.
The Taoiseach says this is the biggest security job in the State's history. A group will now look at Garda work hours.
sentZh: 警察工會的成員已停止一項原本計畫的職場抗議。
這個工會叫做GRA。
Gardaí是愛爾蘭的警察。
他們原本計畫本週進行為期五天的「依規工作」。
這表示只做最基本的工作。
這項抗議原本會落在非常忙碌的時候。
大約50位世界領袖將於週四在都柏林開會。
歐盟領袖則將在週五開會。
警察說他們工作太多。
從七月以來，他們的休假日經常被取消。
他們的加班時數也沒有一直依照約定支付。
週一，政府為週四的加班提供更多錢。
工會隨後投票停止抗議。
工會表示談判進行得很順利。
總理說這是國家史上最大的保安任務。
一個小組現在將檢視警察的工作時數。

paragraphs: The Garda Representative Association (GRA), the union for most ordinary gardaí, has called off a work-to-rule that was planned for this week. Its leaders voted on Monday evening after what they called important progress in talks with the Garda Commissioner.

A work-to-rule means that workers do only what their contracts say and nothing extra. The action was due to last five days, from Tuesday to Saturday. Earlier on Monday, the union's president, Niall Hodgins, said gardaí were overworked and did not feel valued. He also said members would stop using their own cars for police work.

The timing was very sensitive. On Thursday, around 50 European leaders, including Ukraine's president Volodymyr Zelenskiy, will meet in Dublin for the European Political Community meeting. On Friday, EU heads of state will hold an informal meeting in the city.

The union says its members have had a difficult year. Since Ireland began its EU Presidency on 1 July, many rest days have been cancelled at short notice. The GRA also says that agreed rules on overtime have been broken.
On Monday afternoon, higher payments were announced for gardaí who work overtime on Thursday. Some wider problems will be studied by a group that reviews Garda work rosters.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin said Thursday's event would be the largest security operation in the history of the State. He thanked gardaí for their preparation. The Minister for Justice, Jim O'Callaghan, had asked gardaí to do their best during the week.
sentZh: 代表大多數基層警察的工會「警察代表協會」（GRA）已取消原定本週進行的依規工作。
其領導層在週一晚間投票，此前他們表示與警察總監的談判取得了重要進展。
依規工作是指員工只做合約規定的事，不做任何額外工作。
這項行動原定持續五天，從週二到週六。
週一稍早，工會主席尼爾·霍金斯表示，警察工作過度，而且感覺不受重視。
他也說成員將停止用自己的車執行警務。
時機非常敏感。
週四，包括烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基在內的約50位歐洲領袖將在都柏林出席歐洲政治共同體會議。
週五，歐盟各國元首將在該市舉行非正式會議。
工會表示，其成員度過了艱難的一年。
自愛爾蘭於7月1日開始擔任歐盟輪值主席國以來，許多休假日都在臨時通知下被取消。
GRA也表示，已談妥的加班規定遭到違反。
週一下午，政府宣布將提高週四加班警察的給付。
一些更廣泛的問題將由一個審查警察輪班表的小組研究。
總理米哈爾·馬丁表示，週四的活動將是國家史上規模最大的保安行動。
他感謝警察的準備工作。
司法部長吉姆·奧卡拉漢先前曾要求警察在這一週盡力而為。

paragraphs: The Garda Representative Association (GRA), which represents rank-and-file gardaí, has called off a five-day work-to-rule just days before Dublin hosts its most high-profile EU events. The association's national executive took the decision on Monday evening, saying it had made significant progress in negotiations with the Garda Commissioner, Justin Kelly.

Under a work-to-rule, members carry out only the duties strictly required by their contracts. The action had been due to run from Tuesday until Saturday. Hours before the vote, GRA president Niall Hodgins described gardaí as overworked and underappreciated, and said members would also refuse to use their private cars for policing duties.

The dispute threatened to overshadow a week of major security challenges. On Thursday, about 50 leaders, among them Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskiy, will gather in Dublin for a meeting of the European Political Community. An informal summit of EU heads of state follows on Friday, while protests and a possible public-sector strike march are also planned.

The GRA's complaints centre on the strain placed on its members since Ireland took over the EU Presidency on 1 July. It says overtime agreements have been breached and that rest days have repeatedly been cancelled, and it wants these problems resolved before the Presidency ends.
On Monday afternoon, enhanced premiums were announced for gardaí rostered to work overtime on Thursday. Broader concerns are being examined by the Rosters Review Group.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin called Thursday's event the largest security operation in the history of the State and said all hands would be needed on deck. Minister for Justice Jim O'Callaghan had earlier urged gardaí to do their best, pointing out that there are proper channels for raising industrial relations concerns.

協會的全國執行委員會於週一晚間做出此決定，表示與警察總監賈斯汀·凱利的談判已取得重大進展。
在依規工作期間，成員只執行合約嚴格要求的職責。
這項行動原定從週二持續到週六。
在投票前幾個小時，GRA主席尼爾·霍金斯形容警察工作過度且未受賞識，並表示成員也將拒絕使用私家車執行警務。
這場糾紛恐使充滿重大保安挑戰的一週蒙上陰影。
週四，包括烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基在內的約50位領袖將齊聚都柏林，出席歐洲政治共同體會議。
週五接著舉行歐盟元首非正式高峰會，同時還有抗議活動以及可能的公部門罷工遊行。
GRA的不滿集中在愛爾蘭自7月1日接任歐盟輪值主席國以來，成員所承受的壓力。
協會表示加班協議遭到違反、休假日一再被取消，並希望這些問題在主席國任期結束前獲得解決。
週一下午，政府宣布為排定週四加班的警察提高加給。
更廣泛的問題則正由輪班審查小組研究。
總理米哈爾·馬丁稱週四的活動為國家史上規模最大的保安行動，並表示需要全員出動。
司法部長吉姆·奧卡拉漢稍早曾敦促警察盡力而為，並指出已有適當管道可以提出勞資關係方面的疑慮。

paragraphs: The Garda Representative Association (GRA), the body representing rank-and-file officers, has abandoned a planned five-day work-to-rule on the eve of the most prestigious diplomatic gatherings ever staged in Dublin. Its national executive reached the decision on Monday evening, citing substantial headway in negotiations with Garda Commissioner Justin Kelly.

A work-to-rule obliges members to confine themselves to the bare minimum their contracts stipulate, and the action had been slated to run from Tuesday through to Saturday. Only hours before the climbdown, GRA president Niall Hodgins had portrayed his members as overstretched and undervalued, vowing that they would also decline to use their own vehicles for policing duties.

The stand-off had threatened to cast a shadow over an extraordinarily demanding week. Roughly 50 leaders, Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskiy among them, are due to convene in the capital on Thursday for the European Political Community, with an informal summit of EU heads of state to follow on Friday. Protests and a possible public-sector strike march add further pressure on an already stretched force.

At the heart of the grievance is the toll exacted on officers since Ireland assumed the EU Presidency on 1 July. The association alleges that overtime arrangements have been flouted and rest days cancelled time and again, and it insists these matters be rectified for the remainder of the Presidency.

The breakthrough followed Monday afternoon's announcement of enhanced premiums for officers rostered on overtime for Thursday, while more far-reaching issues have been referred to the Rosters Review Group.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin, who has described Thursday as the largest security operation in the history of the State, said it would require all hands on deck and paid tribute to the force's meticulous preparations. Minister for Justice Jim O'Callaghan had earlier appealed to gardaí to rise to the occasion, stressing that established mechanisms exist for airing industrial relations disputes.

其全國執行委員會於週一晚間做出決定，理由是與警察總監賈斯汀·凱利的談判已取得實質進展。
依規工作要求成員只做合約規定的最低限度工作，這項行動原定從週二一直持續到週六。
就在讓步前幾小時，GRA主席尼爾·霍金斯還形容成員負荷過重、不受重視，並誓言他們也將拒絕使用自己的車輛執行警務。
這場僵局原本可能為極其艱鉅的一週蒙上陰影。
約50位領袖，包括烏克蘭的澤倫斯基，將於週四齊聚首都出席歐洲政治共同體會議，週五還有歐盟元首的非正式高峰會。
抗議活動與可能的公部門罷工遊行，也讓本已人手吃緊的警隊壓力更大。
不滿的核心在於愛爾蘭自7月1日擔任歐盟輪值主席國以來對員警造成的負擔。
協會指稱加班安排遭公然違反、休假日一再被取消，並堅持這些問題必須在主席國任期剩餘期間獲得糾正。
突破出現在週一下午宣布為排定週四加班的員警提高加給之後，而影響更深遠的問題已移交輪班審查小組。

司法部長吉姆·奧卡拉漢稍早曾呼籲警察不負所託，並強調已有既定機制可表達勞資糾紛。

paragraphs: The Garda Representative Association (GRA), which represents the majority of front-line police officers in Ireland, has rescinded a proposed five-day work-to-rule shortly before Dublin hosts a series of exceptionally high-profile international meetings. The decision, taken by the association's national executive on Monday evening, was attributed to considerable progress in negotiations with Garda Commissioner Justin Kelly.

A work-to-rule requires employees to perform only those duties that are explicitly specified in their contracts; consequently, it can substantially reduce operational capacity without constituting a full strike. The action had been scheduled to take place from Tuesday to Saturday. Earlier on Monday, the GRA president, Niall Hodgins, had characterised officers as overburdened and insufficiently valued, and had indicated that they would also refuse to use private vehicles for official duties.

The potential consequences of the dispute were considerable. Approximately 50 heads of government, including the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, are expected in Dublin on Thursday for the European Political Community, and an informal summit of EU leaders will follow on Friday. In addition, several protests and a possible public-sector strike march are anticipated.

The association's grievances relate primarily to the cumulative pressure placed on officers since Ireland assumed the EU Presidency on 1 July. It maintains that overtime agreements have been breached and that rest days have been cancelled on numerous occasions, and it argues that these issues must be resolved for the remainder of the Presidency.

The agreement was facilitated by the introduction, on Monday afternoon, of enhanced premiums for officers scheduled to work overtime on Thursday. Nevertheless, a number of broader concerns remain contingent upon the findings of the Rosters Review Group.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin described the forthcoming event as the most extensive security operation in the history of the State and emphasised that it would require the full commitment of the force. The Minister for Justice, Jim O'Callaghan, had previously urged officers to cooperate, noting that formal mechanisms already exist for addressing industrial relations concerns.

依規工作要求員工只執行合約中明確規定的職責；因此，它能在不構成全面罷工的情況下大幅降低執勤能力。
這項行動原定於週二至週六進行。
週一稍早，GRA主席尼爾·霍金斯曾形容警員負擔過重且未獲充分重視，並表示他們也將拒絕使用私人車輛執行公務。

約50位政府首長，包括烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基，預計將於週四抵達都柏林出席歐洲政治共同體會議，週五還將接著舉行歐盟領袖非正式高峰會。
